blendermix_v20.safetensors._note: Civitai offers one file for v2.0: 6.62 GB, fp16, full. min_bytes only guards against a truncated download, so a smaller build of the same model already on disk still counts.

flux-2-klein-9b-fp8.safetensors._note: 9.44 GB. black-forest-labs gates this one, so the app's own gated path handles it: it shows the licence link, checks whether the account has already accepted, and says so. z-image-vae.safetensors._note: Served as ae.safetensors and saved under the name the graph asks for.

nsfwKlein.safetensors._note: 8.45 GB. Open repo, no token needed. The origin reports 9078610848 bytes, which is the size on the machine this was converted from.

realism-sdxl.safetensors._note: 6.46 GB. Open repo. The origin reports 6938075194 bytes.

controlnet-union-sdxl-1.0.safetensors._note: 2.34 GB. Served as diffusion_pytorch_model_promax.safetensors and saved under the name the graph asks for. The promax build is the one that carries the inpainting mode this workflow selects.

wan2.2_t2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.saf._note: 13.31 GB. Wan 2.2 14B runs as a pair - high noise first, then low - so both halves are needed.

wan2.2_t2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safe._note: 13.31 GB. Wan 2.2 14B runs as a pair - high noise first, then low - so both halves are needed.

wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safe._note: 13.31 GB. Wan 2.2 14B runs as a pair - high noise first, then low - so both halves are needed.

nsfw_wan_umt5-xxl_fp8_scaled.safetensors._note: 6.27 GB. This is the part that is actually NSFW-specific here - an uncensored UMT5 text encoder. The diffusion models above are stock Wan.

wan_animate_2_distill_int8_convrot.safet._note: Wan-Animate-2 distilled (Aug 2026), Comfy-Org int8 convrot 16.7 GB: 10 steps, lcm, cfg 1.

clip_vision_h.safetensors._note: First-to-last frame only: it encodes both end pictures so the clip knows where it starts and stops.

rife49.pth._note: 20.4 GB is a typo waiting to happen - it is 21345274 bytes, about 20 MB. RIFE keeps its checkpoint inside its own pack folder rather than under ComfyUI/models, which is what root_relative_path is for. The node would fetch it itself, but its first source answers 404 for this file, so it is fetched here from the mirror the pack falls back to - up front, with a progress bar, instead of mid-run.

Wan2.2-High-MysticXXX-v2.safetensors._note: 293 MB. Wan LoRA - 800 tensors on diffusion_model.blocks.*, checked by reading the safetensors header rather than trusting the repo name. All four are the same byte count and four different sha256s: same architecture and rank, different weights. The high-noise half of a pair; Wan 2.2 samples twice and needs both.

Wan2.2-I2V-High-MysticXXX.safetensors._note: 293 MB. Wan LoRA - 800 tensors on diffusion_model.blocks.*, checked by reading the safetensors header rather than trusting the repo name. All four are the same byte count and four different sha256s: same architecture and rank, different weights. The high-noise half of a pair; Wan 2.2 samples twice and needs both.

Wan2.2-I2V-Low-MysticXXX.safetensors._note: 293 MB. Wan LoRA - 800 tensors on diffusion_model.blocks.*, checked by reading the safetensors header rather than trusting the repo name. All four are the same byte count and four different sha256s: same architecture and rank, different weights. The low-noise half of a pair; Wan 2.2 samples twice and needs both.

wan22-f4c3spl4sh-100epoc-high-k3nk.safet._note: 319116504 bytes, sha256 begins a68ee10bb0f3 - which is the same file as the one this pack was built against, hashed on both sides rather than matched on size. The high-noise half; the two halves are different epochs and different sizes, which is what the source published.

wan22-f4c3spl4sh-154epoc-low-k3nk.safete._note: 306807976 bytes, sha256 begins 683d6a84430b - which is the same file as the one this pack was built against, hashed on both sides rather than matched on size. The low-noise half; the two halves are different epochs and different sizes, which is what the source published.

Moody-Krea-Mix-v7_00002__clean_convrot_i._note: Moody Krea 2 Mix v7 (the author's own Hugging Face repo), int8 convrot 14.1 GB - a community Krea 2 Turbo merge tuned for uncensored realism. Hugging Face, so no account or key; the Civitai V8 build refused downloads (403) even with a key.

krea_kroma_v0.3.1_turbo_opd_int8_convrot._note: Kroma v0.3.1 Turbo OPD (Lodestones, the Chroma author) - a full fine-tune of Krea 2 with the Turbo delta merged in, on-policy distilled. int8 convrot build (14.1 GB) of lodestones/Kroma's 26 GB bf16. Same Krea 2 text encoder and VAE; Krea 2 LoRAs carry over.

qwen-image-2.1-UC-int8_convrot.safetenso._note: Qwen-Image 2.1 base, uncensored (abenzerps), int8 convrot 7.3 GB. The most downloaded uncensored Qwen 2.1 build (2.7M). Qwen research licence.

MidJounreyNSFWKrea2Raw.safetensors._note: Spelling is the upstream file's, typo and all - it is the filename the graph asks for.

Krea2-realism-V2.safetensors._note: Realism LoRA for Krea 2: real skin, anatomy and photo look, SFW and NSFW. The author's weights: ~1 for realism, 1.5-2 for explicit scenes.

minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safet._note: 690,592,672 bytes. Served as minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors and saved under the name the graph asks for. The fp16 safetensors build, not the fp32 .pth: the node opens a .pth with torch.load(weights_only=False), which is pickle and can run code, and it runs at fp16 either way. The URL once pointed at the repo root and 404d - the files live in the conv_v1 folder.

minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_m._note: 20.98 GB. MiniMax H3 ref2va base, fused refdelta + turbo (8-step), int8 quant. The heavy one - nearly fills a 24 GB card at the sampling pass, so ComfyUI offloads it around the 32B text encoder. Keep frames x megapixels under ~540 per shot or it OOMs.

qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safeten._note: 15.69 GB. Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder for MiniMax H3, NVFP4 (4-bit) AWQ - the smallest of three builds (int8 is 27 GB, bf16 51 GB), the only one that fits a 24 GB card. NVFP4 is native on RTX 50-series; on Ampere (3090) it runs via dequant, so slower but functional.

minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safete._note: 2.81 GB. The int8 video VAE (not the 5.21 GB fp16) - chosen to save VRAM on a tight 24 GB card; negligible quality difference at decode.

Chroma1-HD.safetensors._note: Chroma1-HD, ~17.8 GB bf16. Open repo (lodestones), no token. min_bytes only guards a truncated download.

flan-t5-xxl_float8_e4m3fn_scaled_stochas._note: flan-t5-xxl encoder, fp8 scaled. Chroma reads its prompt through this, loaded with CLIPLoader type 'chroma'. Open repo.

ae.safetensors._note: The Flux/Lumina ae.safetensors VAE, the file Chroma's VAELoader asks for by name. Distinct from z-image's VAE, which is saved as z-image-vae.safetensors.

h3-realism-people-t2v-i2v-r2v.safetensor._note: 131,229,656 bytes. fal MiniMax H3 Realism People LoRA (t2v, i2v, r2v). Trigger word r34l1sm; scale 1.0, 0.6-0.8 for a lighter touch. Offered as a switch on MiniMax H3 Infinite, fetched on first use.

TaoMate-H3-3step-ComfyUI.safetensors._note: 1,240,539,224 bytes. MiniMax H3 3-step distill LoRA, for very few steps. Offered as a switch on MiniMax H3 Infinite, fetched on first use.

H3_SPEED_slider.safetensors._note: 149,166,648 bytes. Experimental MiniMax H3 speed slider LoRA. Offered as a switch on MiniMax H3 Infinite, fetched on first use.

Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v1.3_Prune._note: 11.8 GB - the same w4a8 size class as the app's own H3 build, so it sits beside the text encoder on 24 GB. A finetune of the H3 reference model (sharper faces at a distance, cleaner skin, stronger motion). The repo also has a pruned int8 (21 GB) and a full int8 (34 GB); Short film uses whichever is here.

ultrarealFineTune_v4_fp8.safetensors._note: UltraReal Fine-Tune v4, the full fp8 safetensors build (11.08 GB) - the owner's graph loads it as fp8_e4m3fn_fast. Civitai: needs the Civitai key. Saved under this name.

MysticXXX-V3.safetensors._note: Mystic XXX for Flux, v3 (148 MB) - the version the owner's graph uses. Civitai: needs the Civitai key.

flx-cl-remover.safetensors._note: Clothes remover LoRA for FLUX Kontext, 344 MB. Open repo.

fluxFillFP8_v10.safetensors._note: FLUX.1 Fill dev in fp8, 11.9 GB. Open repo - the source the owner's own FLUX workflows name.

flux1-dev-kontext_fp8_scaled.safetensors._note: FLUX.1 Kontext dev, fp8 scaled, 11.9 GB, Comfy-Org's open repackage. Saved in checkpoints because the Kontext graphs load it with CheckpointLoaderSimple, as the owner's own graph does.

H3_POV_Missionary_Insertion.safetensors._note: POV missionary insertion. 0.6-0.8; wants a turbo LoRA, 6-8 steps, euler/simple.
